::: {#exr-few-labels}

#### Twenty labelled images

Suppose we must classify the digits 5 to 9
but have labels for only 20 images of them.
`draw_few()` draws 20 such training images at random,
and relabels the digits 5 to 9 as classes 0 to 4.
Train `make_cnn(n_classes=5)` from its random starting weights on each draw,
for 30 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch).
How accurate is it on the test images of the digits 5 to 9,
averaged over 10 draws of the 20 images?

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
n_few = 20
n_draws = 10
is_high = y_train >= 5
x_high, y_high = x_train[is_high], y_train[is_high] - 5
x_high_test = x_test[y_test >= 5]
y_high_test = y_test[y_test >= 5] - 5


def draw_few(draw):
    # Draw `n_few` labelled training images of the digits 5 to 9.
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(draw)
    chosen = torch.randperm(len(x_high), generator=generator)[:n_few]
    return x_high[chosen], y_high[chosen]


print(len(x_high), len(x_high_test))
```

:::
